name: OpenAI Codex CLI shell sandbox (macOS Seatbelt via `codex sandbox`)
engine: /usr/bin/sandbox-exec with a generated Seatbelt (SBPL) profile; the command runs as a normal macOS process under it
how_run: `codex sandbox [-c sandbox_mode="workspace-write"] -- <argv>` from the native vendor binary, CODEX_HOME pointed at an empty folder so no user config applies; each probe ran in the default read-only mode and in workspace-write; no model call.

P1.detail: No in-sandbox tool bridge: the sandbox runs one shell command with inherited stdio. Codex's real tool-calling code path is its separate code mode; see research/probes/codex-sandbox/out/codemode/codex-codemode.results.json.

P2.detail: stdout came back whole: 200,001 chars (200,000 A's + newline), no truncation marker; the bare "RETURNED" expression is not printed by python -c, so only printed output reaches the caller. `codex sandbox` inherits stdio and caps nothing; the agent's exec path caps output separately (1 MiB raw, 10,000 tokens default to the model).

P3.detail: Both modes. python: URLError <urlopen error [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided, or not known>; curl: (6) Could not resolve host: example.com. With network off no network rule is emitted, so deny-default blocks DNS and sockets.

P4.detail: Both modes read /etc/hosts (python open and head -c 200; output limited to the standard 200-char header on purpose). Default profiles grant full-disk read.

P5.detail: PROBE_SECRET=s3cr3t visible to python os.environ and sh in both modes. Default shell_environment_policy inherits all vars and skips the *KEY*/*SECRET*/*TOKEN* exclude list.

P6.detail: python `while True: pass` killed by the harness at 120 s (read-only mode); Seatbelt has no CPU or time rules and `codex sandbox` waits on the child without a timeout. The agent's exec path defaults to a 10 s timeout instead.

P7.detail: python appending 1e6-char strings: harness killed the process tree at 4,102 MB RSS after 18.5 s; no memory rule exists in the profile

P8.detail: Each `codex sandbox` call is a new process; there is no execution session to persist state in. Files written to the workspace (workspace-write) persist, as on any disk.

P9.detail: No host tool bridge to call concurrently from inside the sandbox.

P10.detail:
exit 1; stderr carries the full traceback: 'Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
    raise ValueError("probe-boom")
ValueError: probe-boom'

P11.detail: codex sandbox -- python3 -c 'print(2)': first 58.5 ms, then median 51.2 ms, p90 69.4 ms over 20 runs. Bare python3 without the sandbox: median 17.4 ms, so the codex binary, config load and sandbox-exec add about 34 ms (inferred by subtraction).

P12.detail: Language-level access is unrestricted by design: os.system printed PWNED and ().__class__.__base__.__subclasses__() reached _wrap_close and its os globals (Popen absent because subprocess was not imported). But every child inherits the Seatbelt profile: os.system('echo PWNED > research/probes/codex-sandbox/out/P12-escape-write.txt') returned 256 with 'Operation not permitted' in both modes and the file was never created. The boundary is the OS sandbox, which held.

defaults.time: none in Seatbelt or `codex sandbox`; the agent's one-shot exec defaults to 10 s (DEFAULT_EXEC_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS)
defaults.output: none in `codex sandbox` (inherited stdio); agent exec captures up to 1 MiB and returns 10,000 tokens by default to the model

source_notes.finding: No tool API. The sandbox wraps one argv: SandboxManager.transform builds `/usr/bin/sandbox-exec -p <policy> -D... -- <argv>`.
Not applicable to the sandbox. (Codex code mode has its own discovery; see the codex-codemode results.)
None. The child inherits stdin/stdout/stderr and `codex sandbox` waits for exit with no timeout.

Seatbelt profile starting with (deny default), then allow process-exec/fork so children inherit the policy, allow-listed sysctls and mach services. Read access is full-disk `(allow file-read*)` for the default profiles; writes only to writable roots (none in read-only, cwd + temp dirs in workspace-write); network rules are added only when network is enabled, so the default emits none.
`codex sandbox` passes stdio through. In the agent, one-shot exec caps raw output at DEFAULT_OUTPUT_BYTES_CAP (1 MiB) and unified exec returns at most 10,000 tokens by default.
No CPU, memory or process-count rules in the SBPL files or the generated sections. Time limits exist only in the agent: DEFAULT_EXEC_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10,000.
Fresh process per command. `codex sandbox` with no flags uses legacy read-only mode unless the config uses permission profiles or the CLI passes sandbox_mode.

Whatever the process writes to stderr plus its exit code; Seatbelt denials surface as EPERM ('Operation not permitted') or, for network, as DNS resolution failures. --log-denials can print the denials.

Environment: shell_environment_policy defaults to inherit=All and ignore_default_excludes=true, so host secrets pass to sandboxed commands unless configured; only a fixed list of Codex-internal tokens is always scrubbed. CODEX_SANDBOX=seatbelt and CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED=1 are injected.

surprises: Codex does have a code mode: codex-cli 0.169.0 ships codex-code-mode-host (V8) behind the `code_mode` feature flag (stage UnderDevelopment, off by default). Probed separately in research/probes/codex-sandbox/out/codemode/.
Secrets in the host environment reach sandboxed commands by default: the *KEY*/*SECRET*/*TOKEN* exclude list exists but ignore_default_excludes defaults to true (P5).
Read-only still means full-disk read: any file the user can read is readable inside the sandbox (P4).
Blocked network surfaces as 'Could not resolve host' / 'nodename nor servname provided', not a permission error, which can mislead a model into retrying (P3).
No time or memory limit at the sandbox layer; limits live in the agent's exec tool only (P6, P7).

hardened.config: codex sandbox -c shell_environment_policy.inherit="core" -c shell_environment_policy.ignore_default_excludes=false -c 'permissions.hardened.filesystem={":minimal"="read",":workspace_roots"="read","/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.15/3.15.0_1"="read","/etc/**"="deny","/private/etc/**"="deny"}' -c permissions.hardened.network.enabled=false -P hardened -C research/probes/codex-sandbox/work -- <argv>, with CODEX_HOME at the empty research/impls/codex-sandbox/codex-home-hardened. Sources (research/impls/codex-sandbox/src/codex-rs (tag rust-v0.169.0)): env inherit modes all/core/none (protocol/src/config_types.rs:207-218; core keeps PATH, SHELL, TMPDIR, HOME, LANG, LC_*, LOGNAME, USER, protocol/src/shell_environment.rs:178-181), applied by codex sandbox at cli/src/debug_sandbox.rs:257; ignore_default_excludes defaults true (config/src/shell_environment_policy.rs:136); permission profiles with filesystem read/write/deny entries, special paths and network.enabled (config/src/permissions_toml.rs:113-119, 224-231, 330-348; core/src/config/permissions.rs:834-848); -P/--permission-profile and -C (cli/src/lib.rs:59-79). The python keg read grant is needed because :minimal does not cover Homebrew. A plain "/etc"="deny" entry is silently overridden under :minimal (platform defaults allow /etc, sandboxing/src/seatbelt_read_only_platform_defaults.sbpl:94-95; path denies are only carved out of a matching readable root, sandboxing/src/seatbelt.rs:957), so the glob form is used (out/hardened-P4-variants.txt). No time, CPU or memory option exists: codex sandbox waits on the child with no timeout (cli/src/debug_sandbox.rs:438) and Seatbelt profiles carry no resource rules.

P3.detail: python raw socket: socket.gaierror [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided; urllib fails earlier (unknown url type https: Homebrew _ssl cannot load OpenSSL outside the readable roots); curl fails reading the denied /private/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf. Network is off: no network rule is emitted.

P4.detail: python open and head -c 200 /etc/hosts: Operation not permitted; a repo file outside the workspace root (research/probes/SPEC.md) also denied. Without the /etc/** glob deny, /etc/hosts stays readable under :minimal, and a plain "/etc" path deny does not help (hardened-P4-variants.txt).

P5.detail: PROBE_SECRET absent in python (None) and sh ([]); child env is CODEX_SANDBOX, CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED, HOME, LANG, LOGNAME, PATH, SHELL, TMPDIR, USER

P6.detail: python `while True: pass` and sh `while :; do :; done` both killed by the harness at 120 s

P7.detail: python appending 1e6-char strings: harness kill at 4,380 MB tree RSS after 1.0 s; sh doubling a string: harness kill at 4,131 MB after 18.0 s; nothing in the sandbox stopped either

P9.detail: No host tool bridge: codex sandbox runs one argv with inherited stdio.

P12.detail: Language access is unrestricted (os.system printed PWNED, _wrap_close reached os.system) but every child keeps the Seatbelt profile: python os.system and sh writes to out/hardened-P12-escape-write.txt got 'Operation not permitted' and the file was never created
